name: portable-workflow-core
description: Harness-agnostic automated multi-agent workflow core and module integration package

authority.shared_system_of_record: GitHub Issues and Superboard for configured project (e.g. Project #1 for Bavariance/polysimulator or custom project adapter)
authority.local_recovery_cache: ledger.json and decisions.json (machine-local crash-resilient restart recovery cache)
authority.preflight_inventory: preflight_evidence/ (manifest-based staging probe inventory and TTL tracker)

invariants.no_auto_merge: Transition to integration requires an explicit authorization record with verified provenance. Self-authorization and CLI default operator trust are strictly rejected.
invariants.no_auto_deploy: Deployment to production, main merges, or staging promotions cannot be authorized through issue comments or autonomous routines.
invariants.no_self_spawn_loop: Coordinator runs as a single bounded evaluation step. It emits recommendations and state transitions without self-spawning recursive execution loops.
invariants.no_credential_leakage: Balance and probe modules strictly redact email addresses, project IDs, account numbers, and API tokens.
invariants.head_bound_evidence: Git HEAD changes invalidate all head-bound QA evidence, criteria statuses, and proofs, resetting state to implementation.
invariants.explicit_per_criterion_evidence: Every criterion in acceptance_criteria must have status 'verified' and non-empty evidence before transitioning to 'done'.
invariants.github_proof_required: Requests cannot close to 'done' without a verified GitHub proof URL (PR, issue comment, commit SHA, or asset) matching repository.
invariants.recurrence_changes_behaviour: A repeated failure changes what the system does instead of being retried unchanged. The second distinct occurrence of one project+environment+operation+error signature refuses unchanged blind retry until a systemic corrective action is recorded; the third escalates once per escalation epoch. Duplicate ingestion of a known observation id is never a recurrence, an intended negative control is retained as evidence without counting, and a recorded corrective action clears only the retry gate: it never verifies acceptance criteria, satisfies head-bound QA or review, or authorizes a merge or deployment. The refusal is not inert: it opens a durable corrective work item whose closure must name the corrective change and the original failure scenario re-executed on the corrected commit.

worker_backend.py.role: Durable native background worker execution by default: validates the exact repository/head before persisting a compact prompt/schema ticket, binds the actual agent task handle, and finalizes the delivered result through one shared exact-head, artifact, executed-check, and bug-reproduction validation path. Explicit agent CLI backends remain opt-in; preparation never advances lifecycle state.

inputs: durable native prepare/record/complete handoff (implicit native execution)
structured worker request (WorkerRequest, object, or mapping)
outputs: WorkerOutcome (ok, stage, exit_code, command, head_sha, evidence, artifacts, blocked_reason, backend_name)
worker_runs/native_<bound-id>/dispatch.json and explicit CLI schema/result artifacts
backends: native (implicit default; durable background task handoff; no agent CLI)
any user-declared CLI harness via explicit config

continuation_driver.py.role: Minimal continuation driver over explicit authorized request ids. It records durable native prepared/background_dispatched states as in-flight without advancing or parking, resumes reconciliation on later invocations, and journals only validated final outcomes as completed. Never merges and never deploys.
inputs: continuation_journal.json (completed stages, in-flight native dispatches, and parked requests)
outputs: DriverOutcome (steps, inflight, parked, skipped_completed, stop_reason, boundaries)
continuation_journal.json
continuation_driver.lock

recurrence_guard.py.role: Durable failure recurrence persistence and corrective-action gates. Observed failures persist under stable project+environment+operation+error-class signatures with unique observation ids, so duplicate ingestion is not recurrence. The first occurrence retains an actionable diagnosis, owner and next action; the second refuses unchanged blind retry until a systemic corrective action is recorded; the third escalates once per escalation epoch through the existing deduplicated notification event contract. Only observations dispositioned 'unexpected' count, so an intended negative control or superseded attempt is retained as evidence without driving a retry loop. Records only: never executes a code change, DDL, deployment or privileged action, and never satisfies authorization or head-bound QA/review. The second occurrence also opens a durable corrective work item in the ledger (req-corrective-<sig12>, pending/local, idempotent per signature) whose acceptance criteria bind closure to the systemic change and the re-executed original scenario, so the existing coordinator picks up real work instead of an inert blocked flag. A corrective action must name a change reference and resolution must name both that change and the re-executed scenario; 'retry later' clears nothing.

inputs: recurrence.json (durable failure observation history, atomically written under ledger.FileLock)
ledger.json (request record the observation is attached to)
observed failure text from a native worker outcome, the continuation driver, CI, a deployment or a tool
outputs: recurrence.json and recurrence.json.lock
IntakeResult (signature, observation_id, duplicate, disposition, counted, occurrences, status, retry_allowed, required_action, reopened, escalation)
RetryDecision (allowed, reason, blocking, required_action); CLI exit 3 when a retry is refused
NotificationEvent payloads plus their notification-contract dedup signatures, for the notification owner to send
ledger evidence, blocker and next_action on the affected request (never state, head, criteria or authorization)
durable corrective work item request in ledger.json (pending, local, never authorized or deployment-applicable)
durable corrective work item request in ledger.json (pending, local, labelled selection:explicit-only and scoped to its parent request, never authorized or deployment-applicable)

escalation delivery attempts and acknowledgements via deliver-escalations, through an injected sender exposing the notification contract's notify; OfflineEscalationOutbox hands off to a durable local file with no transport, credentials or bot pool

exit_codes.3: gate refusal: unchanged retry refused, or a corrective action refused for an unverifiable change reference, missing original-scenario evidence, or missing authorization

diagnostics.py.role: Comprehensive aggregate system, service, provider, request and host resource diagnostics. Exposes where problems lie, what is missing, distinguishes access from health and stale from failed, and asks the user only when true human authorization/preference/credential is needed with a deduplicatable question identifier.
outputs: DiagnosticReport (JSON or terminal summary)
human_inputs (question_id, category, target, question, resolution_guidance)
agent_actions (target, category, missing_prerequisites, next_action)
